title: High Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2003

sections.shortTitle: High Court Judges Leave Pension and Privileges Amendment Order 2003
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PRESIDENT'S ORDER 3 OF 2003
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
3 OF 2003
HIGH COURT JUDGES
(LEAVE, PENSION AND PRIVILEGES) (AMENDMENT) ORDER, 2003
An Order further to amend the High Court Judges
(leave, Pension and Privileges) Order, 1997
[Gazette of Pakistan,
Extraordinary, Part I, 2nd
December, 2003]
F.No.2(2)/2003‑Pub,
dated 2‑12‑2003.‑‑‑The following order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) this Order may be called the High Court
Judges (Leave, Pension and Privileges) (Amendment) Order, 2003.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on and from the first day of
July, 2003.

2. Amendment of paragraph 21,
P.O. No.3 of 1997.‑‑In the High Court Judges (Leave, Pension
and Privileges) Order, 1997, (P.O. No.3 of 1997), hereinafter referred to as
the said Order, in paragraph 21, in sub paragraph (2), for the words
"twenty‑five thousand" the words "Twenty- eight thousand
seven hundred and fifty" shall be substituted.
